word: My second story is about love and loss.
meaning: 我的第二個故事是關於愛與失去。
example: He introduces the second of his three stories, which is about love and losing something important.
hint:
中文解釋：清晰的段落標誌句，引入第二個故事的主題——充滿情感的失去與轉機。
1) second story (n.): 第二個故事；syn: second tale; ant: first / third story
2) love and loss (phr.): 愛與失去；syn: passion and setback; ant: indifference and gain
pronunciation: Clear announcement: My SEC-ond STO-ry | is a-BOUT | LOVE and LOSS.

example: He considers himself fortunate for what happened early in his life.
hint:
中文解釋：簡單的自我評價，為下一句「找到所愛」的幸運鋪墊。
1) lucky (adj.): 幸運的；syn: fortunate; ant: unlucky
2) was (v.): 過去式，強調這是回顧；syn: felt; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Simple + warm: I WAS luck-y. (brief, genuine)

word: I found what I loved to do early in life.
meaning: 我在人生早期就找到了自己熱愛做的事。
example: At a young age, he discovered his true passion and calling.
hint:
中文解釋：呼應演講主題「Stay Hungry」——找到所愛是幸運，也是整個故事的起點。
1) found (v.): 找到；syn: discovered; ant: lost
2) early in life (phr.): 在人生早期；syn: at a young age; ant: late in life
pronunciation: Grateful: I FOUND | what I LOVED to DO | EAR-ly in LIFE.

word: Woz and I started Apple in my parents' garage when I was 20.
meaning: Woz（沃茲尼克）和我在我二十歲時，在我父母的車庫裡創辦了蘋果公司。
example: He and his partner founded Apple Computer in a simple garage when he was just twenty years old.
hint:
中文解釋：科技創業史上最著名的故事起點——車庫裡的夢想，成就了一個帝國。
1) garage (n.): 車庫；syn: workshop; ant: headquarters
2) started (v.): 創辦；syn: founded; ant: closed down
pronunciation: Proud memory: WOZ and I | STAR-ted AP-ple | in my PAR-ents' GA-rage | when I was TWEN-ty.

word: We worked hard, and in ten years Apple had grown from just the two of us in a garage into a $2 billion company with over 4,000 employees.
meaning: 我們努力工作，十年後蘋果從車庫裡的兩個人，成長為一家擁有超過四千名員工的二十億美元公司。
example: Through hard work, their small startup became a multi-billion dollar corporation in just ten years.
hint:
中文解釋：驚人的成長軌跡，展示了熱情加努力的力量。
1) grown from... into (phr.): 從…成長為…；syn: expanded from... to; ant: shrank from
2) billion (n.): 十億；syn: a very large amount; ant: million
pronunciation: Epic growth: from JUST the TWO of US | in-to a TWO BIL-lion COM-pa-ny | FOUR thou-sand EM-ploy-ees.

word: We just released our finest creation—the Macintosh—a year earlier, and I'd just turned 30.
meaning: 就在一年前，我們才剛發布了我們最傑出的作品——麥金塔電腦——而我也剛滿三十歲。
example: They had just launched the Macintosh, their greatest product, right before he turned thirty.
hint:
中文解釋：在頂峰的那一刻——最好的產品剛剛問世，自己也正值壯年，卻即將遭遇人生巨變。
1) finest creation (n.): 最傑出的作品；syn: greatest achievement; ant: worst failure
2) turned 30 (phr.): 滿三十歲；syn: reached thirty; ant: was still in his twenties
pronunciation: Peak moment: our FIN-est CRE-a-tion | the MAC-in-TOSH | a YEAR EAR-li-er | I'd JUST turned THIR-ty.

example: At that high point, he was suddenly fired from the company he had built.
hint:
中文解釋：最具震撼力的轉折句——在人生巔峰，突如其來的打擊。
1) got fired (phr.): 被解雇；syn: was dismissed; ant: was promoted
2) then (adv.): 然後（表示突然轉折）；syn: suddenly; ant: gradually
pronunciation: Shock: And THEN | I got FIRED. (short pause before, flat but impactful)

word: How can you get fired from a company you started?
meaning: 你怎麼可能被自己創辦的公司解雇呢？
example: He asks the puzzling question of how a founder can be removed from their own company.
hint:
中文解釋：帶點苦澀幽默的反問句，引發聽眾共鳴，也為後面的解釋做鋪墊。
1) get fired (phr.): 被解雇；syn: be dismissed; ant: be promoted
2) company you started (phr.): 你自己創辦的公司；syn: your own company; ant: someone else's company
pronunciation: Rhetorical: How CAN you | get FIRED | from a COM-pa-ny | you START-ed? (rising, puzzled)
